title: Review thread
description: One comment thread, stored as review/<reviewId>/threads/<id>.json. One file per thread is the concurrency unit: two reviewers commenting on different threads never touch the same file, and concurrent comments on ONE thread merge by comment-id union, so review data never produces a textual git conflict. Comments are append-only.

anchor.description: Where the thread hangs. Absent means the thread is on the review request itself. Staleness is never stored — it is computed by resolving `key` against the current project, so reverting a rename un-stales the thread.

key.description: An anchor key — the same path vocabulary localization uses, e.g. dialogue/dlg_arrival/nodes/node_open/text, dialogue/dlg_arrival/nodes/node_open, quest/qst_inquest/stages/stg_body/description, character/npc_wren. Authoritative; entityType and entityId below are denormalized from it for cheap grouping.

entityType.description: ProjectData collection the key addresses, e.g. "dialogues".

comments.description: Append-only. Merges union by id; editing or deleting a comment in place would break that guarantee.

suggestion.description: Proposed replacement text for the anchored field. Only valid on a field anchor (one naming a text field); a suggestion on a structural anchor is a REV error.

appliedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Present once the author applied it.
